burst_definition_confirmed_by_user: Per-block short contiguous bursts under strict blockwise fraction caps; not one global contiguous burst. Ten fixed raw-observation strata per role segment give paired masks across candidate B choices.
block_definition: Generate windows independently within each raw role segment, then partition by prediction timestamps. Input contexts may overlap across blocks; prediction timestamps do not. No window crosses raw role segment boundaries.
H4_block_definition: Partition forecast origins; exclude boundary windows if multi-step targets overlap the next block.
history: Store block raw context and target span, capacity counts blocks. Report actual bytes including repeated context.
development_objective: mean lifecycle MSE across clean and mixed attacks, centers and seeds; tie break smaller B then beta
calibration_constraints: stage-unconditional harmful_commit rate <= 0.05 and mean downside <= epsilon, both conditions separately
